elements.element: Vendor (Array) indemnity against third-party claims alleging IP infringement/misappropriation
elements.evidence: "Array shall indemnify each Ono Indemnitee against any Third Party Claim alleging that any Product or Ono's exercise of the licenses ... infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right of a Third Party"
"excluding any claim arising from Ono's modifications"
"Ono's combinations with other products or materials"

elements.element: Remedy: procure right to continue use
elements.evidence: "procure for Ono the right to continue use"
"refund the amounts paid by Ono for the affected Product"

elements.element: Super-cap of 3× annual fees on Vendor indemnity
elements.evidence: "total liability under this Section 16.2A shall not exceed 3 times the annual fees paid by Ono"

elements.element: Vendor defends and indemnifies Customer and affiliates for IP infringement of services/deliverables
elements.evidence: "indemnify each Ono Indemnitee" (defined to include Ono, its Affiliates and Sublicensees)

elements.element: Indemnity for Vendor's breach of law
elements.evidence: inserted text covers only IP infringement claims; no breach-of-law trigger added

elements.element: Indemnity for data breach caused by Vendor
elements.evidence: no data breach trigger anywhere in inserted 16.2A or existing 16.2

elements.element: Indemnity for Vendor gross negligence/wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: existing clause only carves out "gross negligence or willful misconduct of a Ono Indemnitee"; no affirmative Array GN/WM trigger
no procedure language in the inserted 16.2A; any general procedure section is not shown in the supplied text

elements.element: Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law
elements.evidence: Ono's indemnity limb (a) remains broad: "the use, marketing, distribution, importation or sale of any Product by Ono ... including any Products Liability Claim"

reasons: The locked fallback level is fully satisfied: a new licensor IP indemnity is inserted with all three required exclusions (modifications, combinations, specifications), all four remedies in the required order (procure, modify, replace, refund) and an express 3× annual fees super-cap.

Preferred level is not met (no breach-of-law, data-breach or GN/WM triggers, no express notice/control/cooperation mechanic, and no narrowing of Ono's own indemnity), but that is consistent with the drafter's locked fallback target.
Minimality holds: a single concise insertion addresses an absent clause without touching Sections 16.1/16.2 or rewriting the indemnity architecture; no preferred-only elements were smuggled in.

Intent preserved: the insertion uses existing defined terms ("Ono Indemnitees", "Third Party Claim", "Product", "Third Party"), is self-numbered 16.2A consistent with its internal cross-reference, and leaves all other commercial terms effective.
Note for the rationale only (not a deviation): the cap is measured on fees "paid" rather than "paid or payable", and the clause says "indemnify" without an express duty to defend.
